_comment: Learn center allowlist (DATA, not code) — #309, Studio Phase 3.
Every markdown file the Studio may serve is named here, either as an
explicit repo-relative path or by a closed glob under one directory.
Nothing outside this list is ever read: api/docs.py resolves a slug
through this registry, checks containment under the repo root, and
refuses anything else. 'deny' is a belt-and-braces prefix list applied
to every discovered path (claude_code/ is a stale backward-compat
wrapper with month-old copies of the real docs; doc_internal/ is
gitignored working state). 'kind' decides how titles are derived:
doc = README link text, else the H1; wiki/skill/agent = frontmatter.
'generated_marker' is the line-3 blockquote the generators stamp, so a
generated file is rendered with a badge and never mistaken for prose
'titles' overrides a derived title for files whose H1 is not a name (the README's H1 is a logo block).
